title: A Red Kangaroo Can Hop at 44 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: A red kangaroo can hop at 44 miles an hour.
In short bursts, it reaches about 44 miles an hour.
That's faster than the speed limit on most city streets. It can hold roughly 25 miles an hour for over a mile.
It's the largest of all Australian mammals.
And it does all of this on two legs, hopping.

description:
